purpose: Derive a nonconstant-delay public-client relation and a real witness/fallback decision without new hardware.
source: Existing pinned public MemTest five function definitions, unchanged; new main configures interval q rather than changing those functions.
contracts: Same one-address ordinary-read, accepting scheduled-ready-hit response, one-tick client clock and declared receiver as the serial client. q>Jcache prevents the next poll preceding the response. Watchdog budget 1000; maxLoads=0; controlled command0, no retry.
static_before_trace: s_n=s0+nq; c_n=p*ceil(s_n/p)+ell*p. No waiting polls. For counter period P, N=lcm(p,P)/gcd(q,lcm(p,P)) gives a repeat up to an additive multiple of p and P. J=max(c-s), G=max(q-(c-s)), evaluated over that reachable cycle, not assumed exact at every completion.
query_domain: P=1..9, every phase, K=1 or J+2; one complete period of the joint residue relation per policy. Compare direct read-last completion margin, exact history and service-phase profile, and the per-completion-residue maximum-delay witness condition.
receiver_checks: For the worked P9 historical certificate enumerate size0/1/2 WU subsets independently on each inclusive local interval [100,109],[109,118],[118,127],[127,136], executing both endpoint reads in tick and sparse models. No concatenated-coverage claim.
seed_control: Check F(s0+1)-c0 >= p for aligned original family across all original seeds; exact value 2p at s0 mod p=0, p otherwise. Correct old equality, not the safe lower bound.
interpretation: Source functions execute in existing explicit stubs, not full gem5. Cache timing and queue premises are supplied/source-argued; data coherence not validated. Query equality is relative to independent age G, not every correlation of a whole-program analyzer. New comparisons are prospective local checks with a frozen plan, not an external preregistration or independent hardware validation.
